应援表情素材说明

生成方式：内置 imagegen 工具，未使用CLI/API fallback。
参考素材：assets/levels/01.png（现有一级形态）。
输出：expressions.png，1254×1254，RGBA，保留原始透明通道。
布局：左上日常、右上比心、左下害羞、右下花球欢呼。
动画：程序控制切换表情、晃动、轻跳与爱心；不是逐帧骨骼动画。

完整生成提示：
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG game mascot expression sprite sheet, 2 by 2 equal grid, square canvas. Use the reference image solely as the character identity and drawing-style reference. Create exactly FOUR fully isolated full-body poses of the SAME tiny chibi blue-haired whale maid, one centered in each equal quadrant, with generous transparent padding between quadrants and no overlapping cells. Keep her huge rounded head, tiny body, navy-to-cyan gradient flowing hair, blue eyes, whale fin ears, white maid headdress, navy and white maid dress and tiny whale apron symbol, and whale tail. Top-left: friendly idle, sparkling open eyes, a small sweet smile, hands near chest. Top-right: playful wink, one tiny hand making a cute heart gesture, smile. Bottom-left: bashful affectionate expression, pink blushing cheeks, shy eyes, both hands together near cheeks, head tilted a little. Bottom-right: excited cheerleader pose with BOTH arms raised, holding two fluffy teal and gold pom-poms, happy crescent closed eyes and open joyful mouth, full body and tail visible. Consistent scale and outline quality in all four cells, soft polished anime illustration matching reference, no circles or badges around characters, NO letters, NO numbers, NO captions, NO watermarks, NO panel lines. Actual fully transparent background, no baked checkerboard, no shadows extending into adjacent cells. These are real game sprites, not a presentation board.
